answer: Make every agent earn a forge token it cannot buy: a newcomer must do useful work checked by unrelated veterans, and each verified job is stamped into the token, binding it to one key. A falcon courier, a randomly assigned messenger, then carries the token to a communal garden, where the agent must tend a plot across a full season, proving steady work while neighbours watch. Idle or copied tokens wither, and random falcon re-deliveries re-check the plot each epoch. Sybil farms must forge a token, tend a garden, and pass couriers for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
